independent_review.decision: executor implementation and invented-fixture tests may proceed; real materialization remains unauthorized

required_bindings: append-only DECISIONS.md entry containing all bindings

runtime_evidence_binding.local_dependencies: none; executor imports only the Python standard library
runtime_evidence_binding.archive_validation: no extraction; reject duplicate, unsafe, encrypted, symlink, non-regular, over-limit, CRC-failing, or MANIFEST-inconsistent members
runtime_evidence_binding.authoritative_contract: parse the byte-identical contract member from the authorization-bound evidence ZIP once and execute that immutable in-memory value
runtime_evidence_binding.source_access_gate: all required local runtime files must be byte-identical to their MANIFEST-bound archive members before any source-root inspection or source CSV open
runtime_evidence_binding.system_boundary: self-checking detects accidental or external working-copy drift; it does not claim to defeat an executor deliberately modified to bypass its own checks; Python standard-library bytes are outside this evidence ZIP

output_binding.binding_status: inherited_internal_location_fails_space_check; rebind exact new-volume path before operational approval
output_binding.publish: Darwin renameatx_np with RENAME_EXCL; atomically fail if any destination entry exists; no unsafe fallback
output_binding.publish_unsupported: fail closed on ENOTSUP, EINVAL, ENOSYS, or unavailable renameatx_np
output_binding.new_disk_note: The user expects a new 1 TB disk. No volume name or mount path is assumed in V1R2. A changed root/staging pair requires a reviewed contract rebind and an on-volume no-clobber capability probe.

checks: free bytes at the nearest existing output parent before staging creation
hard cumulative output byte counter before every write
free bytes after every completed feature/label shard pair
hash-only streaming replay writes no files and retains no replay bytes
free bytes after every replayed shard and after each metadata/manifest phase
abort without publishing if any check fails

ordering.input_preflight: validate identity, bytes, SHA-256, header SHA-256, columns, row count, malformed-row count, and newline policy for all 400 inventoried CSV files before staging creation
ordering.data_file_filter: after complete 400-file preflight confirms n_baiot/demonstrate_structure.csv is the one frozen zero-row, well-formed structure file, exclude it from rendering, sorting, and numbering; all other inventoried CSVs are data files
ordering.file_sort: ascending lexicographic order of relative_path encoded as UTF-8 bytes
ordering.shard_id: <ordinal>-<first 16 lowercase hex characters of source file SHA-256>
ordering.row_order: source data-record order with only exact registered CIC malformed final rows removed

source_csv_reading.record_boundary: one physical line is one CSV record; normal records are LF-terminated
source_csv_reading.quoted_multiline_fields: forbidden; fail during complete source preflight
source_csv_reading.parser: RFC 4180-style comma delimiter and doubled double-quote escaping, with strict syntax rejection
source_csv_reading.line_numbering: header is physical line 1; first data record is physical line 2
source_csv_reading.normal_record_terminal_newline: required, including an ordinary final record
source_csv_reading.only_terminal_newline_exception: exactly the three frozen CIC malformed final physical lines whose quality-exception entries have ends_with_newline=false and whose complete registered file/line/raw-byte identities match

csv_serialization.cell_rule: preserve parsed source text exactly; no trimming, case conversion, numeric parsing/reformatting, missing-value replacement, normalization, encoding, or fitting

json_serialization.key_order: schema order specified by this contract; insertion order is normative
json_serialization.jsonl: one complete object per LF-terminated line

n_baiot.source_family: benign or family directory name verbatim
n_baiot.source_subtype: benign_traffic or CSV filename stem verbatim

ciciot2023.capture_id: JSON string: filename after removing terminal .pcap.csv

quality_exception_schema.source_row_rule: physical_line - 1 because the header is physical line 1
quality_exception_schema.match_rule: relative path, frozen source file hash/bytes, final physical line, raw line bytes/hash, and observed/expected column counts must all match; otherwise fail

shard_ledger.row_mapping: output row k maps to the kth non-excluded source data row; all V1 exclusions are final rows, so accepted output row k equals source_row k

root_manifest.line_format: <64 lowercase hex SHA-256><two ASCII spaces><POSIX relative path><LF>
root_manifest.coverage: every regular file under output root except MANIFEST_SHA256.txt itself, exactly once

failure_safety.staging_ownership: create by parent directory descriptor with mode 0700 and retain parent/staging device and inode identity for the complete run
failure_safety.publish_source_identity: immediately before publication, the configured parent and staging directory entries must still match the retained identities
failure_safety.automatic_failure_deletion: forbidden because pathname recursive deletion cannot atomically condition removal on the retained inode
failure_safety.failure_retention: preserve owned staging for audit and report its path/device/inode; no automatic retry
failure_safety.foreign_staging: if the configured staging entry is missing or has another identity, do not delete or modify it; preserve and report both expected and observed identity
failure_safety.cleanup_containment: no pathname rmtree is performed by the executor
failure_safety.contract_change: new reviewed revision and fresh authorization required

explicitly_forbidden: real CSV access during implementation or synthetic testing
real output or staging path creation before authorization
